work.composition: Vertical figure flanked by scattered planes and discs
work.description: Mixed-media collage combining multiple top-down and side-view warplane silhouettes with iridescent compact discs scattered across a vivid painted ground. Bold red and orange vertical forms dominate the center, flanked by blue and white gestural paint, with a small snowman figure and heart motif visible at left.
keywords: warplane silhouette collage with compact discs
work.title: Untitled (Planes and Discs) 1
